units: Balances, property values, revenue and lifetime value are CAD dollars (not thousands or millions). Rates are annual percentages; rate gaps and discounts are basis points (100 bps = 1.00%). Likelihood, LTV and payment shock are percentages, not fractions.
clockBasis: All timing is measured from the snapshot date 2026-08-03 recorded in the source rows, never from the current clock. "This week" means the top of the derived call order, not a calendar week.
disclaimer: SYNTHETIC DEMO ONLY: CFC Bank is a fictional bank and every customer, advisor, mortgage, rate, risk score and offer below is invented for this demonstration. No real customer data is present. Local snapshot scope only: no API calls, no live retrieval, no external facts.
priorityBasis: Call order is derived in this generator from snapshot fields: attrition risk band (High, then Medium, then Low), then fewest days to maturity, then largest balance, then renewal ID. It is an ordering aid, not a model output; the only model output in this data is attrition_risk_score from attrition-renewal-v2.3.
paymentShockBasis: payment_shock_pct is reproduced from mortgage_renewals.csv. Its basis is not documented in the source and a standard annuity recomputation from balance, current rate, offered rate and remaining amortization does not reproduce it, so it is shown as a source-provided figure and is not used in any derived number. 50 of 50 renewals carry a payment_shock_pct that a standard annuity recomputation does not reproduce (for example RNW-5001 records 94.0% against 26.8% recomputed; RNW-5002 records 77.4% against 15.9% recomputed). Both figures are shown per renewal.
offerBasis: Offer eligibility shown here is segment membership from retention_offers.csv only. The conditions in each offer's notes (products held and account types, investable assets, documented competitor evidence, TDS/GDS re-test) cannot be verified from this snapshot and are not treated as met.
holdingsBasis: customers.csv records only how many products each customer holds (products_held), never which ones. The product catalogue and the per-customer holdings list on this page are additional synthetic data authored by this generator: derived deterministically from customer_id, segment, tenure, origination channel, digital engagement, province and the mortgage row, then reconciled so that each list is exactly as long as that customer's recorded products_held. Which products they are is invented; only the count is sourced.
crossSellBasis: Next-best-product entries are propensity indicators for an advisor conversation, drawn from products the customer is not recorded as holding and ordered by a fixed weighting of the snapshot signals listed against each one. The weighting is an ordering aid authored in this generator, not a model output. Nothing here is pre-qualification, an approved offer, a guarantee of eligibility or a credit decision; affordability, suitability and adjudication are unchanged and still sit with the advisor and the relevant credit policy.
marketRateBasis: Live market rates are unavailable in this local scope: this repository holds no Web IQ records, no posted-rate feed and no bond yields, and none were retrieved or inferred. competitor_rate_gap_bps is a scored field from renewal_risk_scores.csv as of the snapshot date - a Fabric-sourced synthetic gap, not a quoted competitor rate and not the documented written competitor offer RP-002 requires before discretionary pricing is granted. Where that evidence is absent it is named as absent rather than assumed.
flyerBasis: A flyer built here is a reviewable draft for a human, not an approved price. The rate shown is the offered renewal rate from mortgage_renewals.csv less the full max_discount_bps ceiling of the selected offer from retention_offers.csv - the maximum discount available under that offer, subject to the approval level named on it (RP-003), and under RP-002 to documented evidence where the offer requires it. It is not a quoted, granted or guaranteed rate. RP-003 discounts do not stack, so exactly one offer is presented and any alternative is shown as a swap, never an addition. RP-007 applies: no deadline pressure beyond the real maturity date, and every condition is disclosed with the offer.
